location: TRF-080-QuantityValueShape and nested effectiveIceLoadCycleCount node shape
problem: The unit constraint uses qudt:UNITLESS in the QUDT schema namespace (http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/UNITLESS), but the authoritative canonical unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS. This constrains the quantity to the wrong unit IRI and can reject correctly represented unitless values.
required_change: Replace both sh:hasValue qudt:UNITLESS constraints with the canonical unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS, using an appropriate unit prefix or full IRI.
regression_guard: Preserve the mandatory exactly-one unitless quantity constraint and the direct calculation without adding tolerance.
